criteria.text: Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 1 June 2029 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 1 June 2031 (48 months after Closing).
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $189,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $188,180,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($950,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Flags the governing law and forum inconsistency between the SPA and the escrow agreement.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($190,000,000 - $910,000 = $189,090,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
